meta.name: add-telegram
meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想给应用增加聊天消息渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Telegram chat to your existing app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add a chat channel to your app.

howto.what: 为项目接入 Telegram 机器人：从 channels 分支复制适配器、配对与 markdown 清理辅助代码及测试并注册，安装 @chat-adapter/telegram@4.29.0，构建并跑注册测试，再引导你建 bot、存 token、重启服务，最后用 4 位配对码把你的聊天接上。
howto.when: 当你要求给项目接入 Telegram 频道或机器人时接管；若你正处在 /setup 流程中，它也会作为其中一步运行。

say.text: 给这个项目加上 Telegram 频道支持
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并注册。

say.text: 帮我创建一个 Telegram 机器人并接进来
用配对码把我的 Telegram 聊天接上
say.note: 先重启服务，再把 4 位码发给 bot。

howto.what_en: Adds a Telegram bot channel: copies the adapter and pairing helpers from the channels branch, registers them, installs @chat-adapter/telegram@4.29.0, builds and tests, then guides bot creation, token storage, restart, and 4-digit pairing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Telegram channel or bot to the project, or as a step inside the /setup flow.

say_en.text: Add Telegram channel support to this project
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs the dep, registers it.

say_en.text: Create a Telegram bot and wire it up for me
say_en.note: Walks you through @BotFather and storing the token.

say_en.text: Pair my Telegram chat with a 4-digit code
say_en.note: Restart the service first; then send the code.
